projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of my most recent work in mobile and web.

items.title: Vantio - Legal Platform
items.desc: Interactive quiz platform and mock exams for lawyers preparing for qualifying exams.

detail.overview: Vantio is a legal preparation platform with interactive quizzes, timed mock exams, progress metrics, and content updated to the Colombian General Process Code.
detail.problem: Law students lacked a modern mock exam platform that combined academic rigor with distraction-free UX and real progress metrics.
detail.solution: Designed and built a full-stack platform with Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, and Motion animations. The UI is dark-mode-first, mobile-first, and optimized for long study sessions.
features: Random mock exams with timer and practice mode
Progress metrics and pass rate by area
Question pool updated to the Colombian General Process Code
Authentication and registration system
Responsive design optimized for long sessions
Native dark mode without additional libraries

items.title: Vantio API - REST Backend
items.desc: REST API powering Vantio: manages questions, mock exams, progress metrics, and authentication.

detail.overview: Vantio backend exposed as a REST API with interactive documentation generated by Scalar. Handles the complete platform domain: question bank, mock exams, study sessions, progress, and authentication.
detail.problem: Needed a solid, versioned, and documented backend that could scale as the legal platform grows in content and users, without sacrificing Developer Experience.
detail.solution: Built a REST API with NestJS following modular architecture, with end-to-end TypeScript, auto-generated OpenAPI, health checks, semantic versioning, and a /api/version endpoint for deployment traceability.
features: Interactive documentation with Scalar UI
Versioned endpoints with semantic versioning
Health check and /api/version endpoint for deployments
Modular architecture by domain (questions, mock exams, users)
JWT authentication with NestJS guards
PostgreSQL + Prisma/TypeORM as persistence layer

items.title: Makii - Restaurant System
items.desc: All-in-one SaaS for restaurants: orders, cash register, roles, court reservations, and events with ticketing.

detail.overview: Makii is an operating system for restaurants that unifies orders, cash register, role management, space reservations (synthetic courts), and events with ticketing — all in a single platform.
detail.problem: Restaurants manage orders, cash register, reservations, and events with disconnected tools, losing traceability and forcing the team to jump between screens and spreadsheets.
detail.solution: Built a responsive web platform with Next.js 15 that centralizes restaurant operations with role-specific views (admin, cashier, kitchen, waiter), reservations by person (not by table), and an upcoming events module.
features: Unified orders and cash register flow
Role-specific views: admin, cashier, kitchen, waiter
Synthetic court reservations by hours and by person
Events with ticketing, access control, and reports
Mobile app and web synchronized in real time
Public roadmap: native delivery module

items.title: AgriGlobal Market - B2B Marketplace
items.desc: Leading platform in the agroindustrial sector that connects suppliers and buyers globally.

detail.overview: AgriGlobal Market is a leading B2B marketplace in the agroindustrial sector, connecting suppliers and buyers across the globe. The platform enables seamless trade of agricultural products with a focus on transparency and efficiency.
detail.problem: The agroindustrial sector lacked a centralized digital marketplace where suppliers and buyers could connect, negotiate, and transact efficiently across borders.
detail.solution: Built a comprehensive web platform with Next.js and ReactJS, featuring real-time product listings, supplier profiles, and a streamlined trade flow optimized for the agricultural industry.
features: Product catalog with advanced search and filters
Supplier and buyer profiles with ratings
Real-time messaging between parties
Multi-language support (EN/ES/PT)
Responsive design for mobile and desktop

items.title: AgriGlobal Market Native App
items.desc: Native app designed to facilitate agricultural trade from anywhere.

detail.overview: Native mobile companion for the AgriGlobal B2B marketplace, enabling traders to browse products, communicate with suppliers, and manage orders on the go.
detail.problem: Traders in the agricultural sector needed mobile access to the marketplace while visiting fields, warehouses, and trade fairs.
detail.solution: Developed a cross-platform React Native app with Expo, using Zustand for state management and NativeWindCSS for consistent styling across iOS and Android.
features: Push notifications for new offers and messages
Offline-first architecture for field use
Native camera integration for product photos
Biometric authentication
Published on both App Store and Play Store

items.title: Baby Shower Macarena - Digital Invitation
items.desc: Interactive landing page designed as a digital invitation for a baby shower, with Cow Chibi theme and soft tactile animations.

detail.overview: A personal project built with love — an interactive digital invitation for my daughter Macarena's baby shower. The page combines minimalism with warm, tactile elements and skeuomorphic details, creating a tender and celebratory visual experience.
detail.problem: Needed a warm, shareable digital invitation that could be easily distributed via WhatsApp and social media, while providing a memorable experience for guests.
detail.solution: Built a single-page interactive experience with React 19, Vite 6, and Tailwind CSS v4. Features include an animated countdown, polaroid gallery, background music, WhatsApp RSVP, and gift list integration.
features: Animated countdown to the event
Polaroid-style gallery with lightbox
Background music with mute toggle
WhatsApp RSVP with pre-filled message
SmileBaby gift list integration
Floating particles (hearts and suns)
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
Scroll spy for active navigation
